objects.name: Unitronics Defacement Campaign
objects.description: The [Unitronics Defacement Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0031) was a collection of intrusions across multiple sectors by the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027), where threat actors engaged in a seemingly opportunistic and global targeting and defacement of Unitronics Vision Series [Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) with [Human-Machine Interface (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002). The sectors that these PLCs can be commonly found in are water and wastewater, energy, food and beverage manufacturing, and healthcare. The most notable feature of this attack was the defacement of the PLCs' HMIs.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: Frank Bajak and Marc Levy December 2023)

external_references.description: DHS/CISA. (2023, December 1). IRGC-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit PLCs in Multiple Sectors, Including U.S. Water and Wastewater Systems Facilities. Retrieved March 25, 2024.

external_references.description_fa: DHS/CISA. (1 دسامبر 2023). بازیگران سایبری وابسته به سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی از PLC ها در بخش های مختلف، از جمله تاسیسات سیستم های آب و فاضلاب ایالات متحده بهره برداری می کنند. بازبینی شده در ۲۵ مارس ۲۰۲۴.

(PLC)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0003) با [رابط انسان و ماشین (HMI)] (https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002). بخش هایی که این PLC ها معمولا در آنها یافت می شوند عبارتند از: آب و فاضلاب، انرژی، تولید غذا و نوشیدنی و مراقبت های بهداشتی. بارزترین ویژگی این حمله، تخریب HMI PLC ها بود.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: Frank Bajak and Marc Levy December 2023)
